Amazon Web Services is seeking an Electronic Health Record Principal Sales Executive to drive revenue growth by helping healthcare provider customers adopt Epic on AWS and transform their healthcare organizations as part of this initiative.

Do you have a passion for building relationships with hospital system executives and helping them realize the business value of cloud computing and AI in support of patient care? Would you like to help set the strategy for helping provider customers get the most out of their Epic application, data, and patient care functions?

Do you have a track record of delivering strategic wins and exceeding revenue targets by helping provider customers drive compelling business outcomes? Are you energized by partnering with customers to position AWS as the platform of choice for mission-critical clinical, operations and financial healthcare systems?

Would you like to influence AWS's strategy on how we help our customers drive value in the Epic EHR ecosystem?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for an experienced and motivated sales/business development professional who aligns with our Leadership Principles and possesses a unique balance of healthcare industry expertise, is comfortable with C-suite conversations, and has consultative selling skills.

You will own strategy, key customer win goals, and revenue targets across a portfolio of healthcare provider accounts, driving adoption of AWS services for Epic EHR workloads.
In collaboration with Solutions Architects, healthcare solution, business development, and partner teams, you will identify key customer accounts, develop account strategies, and lead/coach teams to win strategic multi-year deals.

As a trusted advisor to health system executives, you will help organizations build the business case for migrating Epic environments—including production, alternate production, integrated real-time environments (IRE), data and disaster recovery—to AWS.

You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a go-to-market strategy to build mindshare and accelerate AWS adoption within the healthcare provider segment, specifically focused on Epic EHR.

The ideal candidate must be self-motivated with a proven track record of delivering strategic wins and meeting revenue targets while operating at the C-suite level for healthcare providers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value—including TCO reduction, operational resilience, and clinical outcomes—is critical.

You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about territory planning, competitive positioning, and long-term account growth.
We are looking for someone who is passionate about the following: Our company credo: "Work hard. Have fun. Make history." In this role, you will love what you do, and instinctively know how to make work fun. You will be dynamic and creative, and willing to take on any challenge and make a big impact.

Enjoy working with healthcare provider executives. You will have a passion for understanding hospital system priorities—cost optimization, operational efficiency, clinical innovation—and positioning AWS as the platform that delivers on those priorities for Epic EHR and associated clinical workloads.

Have a strong understanding of enterprise sales cycles in healthcare IT.
The ideal candidate will have past experience selling technology solutions to hospital systems, health system C-suites, and IT leadership. You will enjoy developing deep customer relationships and account strategies, leveraging your healthcare domain knowledge to earn trust at the executive level. You will regularly collaborate with Solutions Architects, Partner teams, and AWS service teams to bring the full power of AWS to bear on customer opportunities.

· Own and exceed annual revenue targets by driving AWS adoption for Epic EHR workloads across a portfolio of healthcare provider accounts
· Coach and mentor sellers on how to develop winning Epic EHR and ecosystem proposals
· Develop and execute account plans that identify migration opportunities, map stakeholder relationships, and define a path from first engagement through close
· Build and maintain a robust pipeline through prospecting, executive networking, industry events, and collaboration with AWS partner and marketing teams
· Lead complex, consultative sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders—translating technical solution value into financial and operational business outcomes for CFOs, CIOs, CTOs, and clinical leadership
· Partner closely with Solutions Architects to ensure proposed solutions meet customer requirements and position AWS competitively against alternative hosting options
· Engage Systems Integrator (SI) partners to support deal progression, including joint selling motions, SOW development, and commercial structuring
· Negotiate and close multi-year commitments, including Enterprise Discount Programs (EDPs), Private Pricing Agreements (PPAs), and migration-linked investment packages
· Serve as the voice of the customer internally—advocating for product enhancements, service improvements, and go-to-market investments that accelerate Epic on AWS adoption
· Build deep, trust-based relationships with senior executives within hospital systems (CEOs, CFOs, CIOs, CTOs, VP Infrastructure) to establish AWS as a long-term strategic partner
· Contribute to the broader AWS Healthcare sales community by sharing best practices, win/loss insights, and reusable deal strategies

Diverse Experiences — AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture — Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship & Career Growth — We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance — We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

The Sales Associate is responsible for providing all Marine Corps Exchange (MCX) customers with world class customer service with an additional emphasis on courtesy.

Sales associates are the primary service providers and will assist customers in every aspect of the retail business in a friendly, professional, and proactive manner that supports continued customer loyalty.

Sales associates assist their customers in challenging scenarios by using an 'I can do that' mindset, to make all attempts for a positive customer experience and outcomes, before asking for support from the next level mentor or supervisor.

Sales associates are brand and customer program ambassadors for all Marine Corps and MCX programs, including but not limited to, Military Star, Super Star Student, customer satisfaction surveys and Keep it New.

This position can be scheduled throughout the facility, based on the needs of the business including but not limited to, cashier or self-checkout attendant, customer service, salesfloor / department support, stockroom / backroom, and military clothing.

In addition to working indoors, associates may be required to work outdoors or inside coolers and/or chillers. Limited time durations and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided when working inside coolers and/or chillers.

Sales associates who are regularly scheduled in areas are expected to learn basic product knowledge to support customer satisfaction and service.

Sales associates perform store operations tasks such as but not limited to, customer and register transactions, Planogram revisions and setups, identifying missing products, replenish sales floor and coolers, setting promotional signage, visual merchandising, maintaining backroom standards through the 5S program and other operational tasks.

Light housekeeping tasks such as but not limited to, sweeping, dusting and trash removal may be part of daily assigned duties. Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

Assists in preparing and participates in year-end inventory and preparation. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. May require additional training or certifications as required by the business and/or normal working assignments, including but not limited to, food safety training and fuel.

Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all team members through positive conversations and driving customer satisfaction in a teams win environment. Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned.

This is a mixed position where the associate must be able to lift and carry objects up to 45 lbs. independently and objects over 45 lbs. with assistance.
At least 1 year experience working in a customer and sales-focused environment is preferred. Cash handling, basic math and register experience strongly preferred. Ability to read and understand operating standards and procedures for service, service recovery, sales and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly. Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals. Attention to detail is required.

Healthcare AI Enterprise Sales Executive New Logo Acquisition | Healthcare AI & Cloud Transformation Rackspace Technology is building the next generation of healthcare AI infrastructure — and we’re hiring a proven enterprise hunter to lead new logo growth across U.S. health systems and IDNs.

This is a pure acquisition role focused on winning new enterprise healthcare customers navigating AI adoption, cloud modernization, data transformation, and operational automation.

You’ll partner with AWS, Microsoft, Google Cloud, and Palantir to bring transformative AI, cloud, and data solutions to some of the largest healthcare organizations in the country.

If you thrive in complex enterprise sales, enjoy building territory from scratch, and want to capitalize on the explosive healthcare AI market, this is a high-impact opportunity with significant earnings upside.

What You’ll Own Build and close a pipeline of net-new healthcare enterprise opportunities Sell complex AI, cloud, data, and managed services solutions into health systems and IDNs Engage CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CMOs, and executive healthcare leadership Drive full-cycle enterprise sales from prospecting through close Lead strategic multi-stakeholder deals ranging from $500K–$5M+ ACV Partner closely with AWS, Azure, GCP, and Palantir field teams Position Rackspace as a trusted healthcare AI transformation partner What You’ll Sell AI/ML infrastructure and GPU environments Managed multi-cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP) Data and analytics platforms HIPAA-compliant security and governance Healthcare AI modernization solutions Palantir Foundry and AIP solutions What We’re Looking For Required Experience 8+ years enterprise technology sales experience Proven success in net-new logo acquisition Experience selling into healthcare providers, IDNs, or health systems Track record closing complex enterprise deals ($500K–$5M+) Strong executive presence and consultative selling skills Experience with cloud, AI, data, analytics, or infrastructure solutions Preferred Experience Existing healthcare executive relationships Experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake, Databricks, or Palantir ecosystems Healthcare AI or digital transformation sales experience Understanding of healthcare data and interoperability environments Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several geographic markets.

The compensation range for this position ranges from $192,610.00/year in our lowest geographic market up to 338,993.60 USD/year in our highest geographic market. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of annual bonus or incentives, equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Learn more about benefits at Rackspace.

We are seeking a seasoned industry professional to join our team as Senior Sales Executive, Health, Medicare & Life, focused on expanding our partnerships within the Life, Health, Medicare, and Property & Casualty insurance industries. This senior-level role will be dedicated to business development—owning the full advertiser sales cycle from prospecting through deal close—while helping define and execute the broader sales strategy in a fast-moving and competitive landscape.
The ideal candidate brings a deep network of insurance contacts, particularly in Life, Health, Medicare, Auto, and Home, Commercial, and has a proven track record of strategic deal-making, contract negotiation, and performance marketing. This is a high-impact role suited for a consultative seller with strong business acumen and a passion for building long-term partnerships.

Collaborate with the GMs of Life, Health, Medicare, Auto, Home, and Commercial to define and drive the vertical’s partnership and sales strategy
Own the full sales cycle: prospecting, proposal development, presentations, contract negotiations, and deal execution
Build and maintain a robust pipeline of advertiser opportunities, maintaining accurate forecasts and CRM records
Deliver best-in-class communication and support to partners, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor
Negotiate complex deals, manage contract redlines, and ensure a high-quality and timely execution process
Work closely with Account Management to ensure a smooth handoff and long-term client success
Partner with the Creative team to prepare compelling marketing and pitch decks
Provide market feedback and industry insights to internal teams to help shape our offerings
Travel up to 20–30% to attend industry events and meet with clients

5+ years of experience in business development or advertiser sales, with a focus on closing large strategic deals
Proven background and existing network in Life, Health, Medicare, or P&C Insurance is strongly preferred
Strong understanding of performance marketing models (e.g., clicks, leads, calls)
Consistent track record of meeting or exceeding revenue goals
Skilled in consultative sales, identifying client pain points and delivering tailored solutions
Extensive experience negotiating complex contract terms and leading redlines processes
Executive presence and confidence communicating with senior stakeholders
Exceptional presentation, writing, and interpersonal communication skills
Proficient in Salesforce, Excel, PowerPoint, and other relevant tools
Passion for growth, partnerships, and high performance
The expected salary range for this position is $120,000 USD to $150,000 USD annually. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on the Company’s compensation practices. The salary may be adjusted based on applicant's geographic location.

This isn't a siloed inbound or outbound role — you'll own both, working the full top of funnel with equal fluency. You'll be the first impression Thinkific makes on prospective customers, and you'll be expected to operate like a modern, AI-native seller: smart targeting, sharp messaging, fast execution.
You'll work closely with our Account Executive team and marketing to help build a qualified pipeline, run signal-based outbound plays, and ensure no inbound lead goes unworked. You'll be expected to use AI tools not as a shortcut, but as a force multiplier — doing more, personalizing better, and moving faster than a traditional SDR.

Build and execute outbound sequences targeting our ICP, using Clay, Gong, Sales Navigator, and AI-driven research to personalize at scale
Run signal-based prospecting using buying triggers (hiring activity, tech stack changes, funding events, content engagement) to prioritize outreach
Execute multi-channel sequences across email, phone, LinkedIn, etc.
Partner with AEs to align on target accounts, messaging, and pipeline goals
Hit and exceed monthly goals
Continuously test and iterate messaging; bring a hypothesis-driven mindset to what's working and why

1-2 years of SDR/BDR experience in B2B SaaS (bonus points for learning tech, HR tech, or an adjacent space)
Demonstrated ability to self-source pipeline through outbound, not just work inbound queues
Hands-on experience with AI-powered sales tools like Clay, Apollo,Gong etc; you should be able to show us your workflow, not just list the tools you’ve used
Proficiency with Salesforce (or equivalent CRM) and a sequencing tool (Outreach, Salesloft, or Gong)
Strong written communication, your emails sound like you, and your cold calls don't sound like scripts
Genuine curiosity about prospects' businesses and a knack for asking questions that uncover real pain

Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment

Souhaitez-vous assumer des responsabilités, avoir un impact et façonner la sécurité de l'information de manière globale du point de vue du CISO ?

Chez Netrics, vous travaillez en tant que membre de notre équipe de conseil à l'intersection de la technologie, des affaires et de la gouvernance - proche du client, des décisions stratégiques et avec une réelle marge de manœuvre.

Rejoignez notre équipe de conseil en cybersécurité et accompagnez les entreprises en tant que partenaire expérimenté dans des questions exigeantes de cybersécurité, de risque et de conformité.
## Voici à quoi ressemble votre travail : ##
* En tant que conseiller principal en cybersécurité, vous représentez Netrics de manière compétente et crédible sur le marché.
* Vous conseillez nos clients de manière globale sur des sujets tels que les stratégies de sécurité de l'information, la gouvernance, le risque et la conformité, la protection des données, l'ISMS, le BCM.
* Avec votre expérience, vous assumez des mandats d'interim CISO chez les clients avec des responsabilités stratégiques, organisationnelles et opérationnelles.
* Vous planifiez, dirigez et assumez la responsabilité des évaluations de sécurité, de risque et de conformité, y compris les évaluations de maturité, les analyses des écarts et les recommandations d'action adaptées à la gestion.
* Vous soutenez l'identification des leads ainsi que la création d'offres de conseil en cybersécurité en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe commerciale et êtes responsable de la mise en œuvre autonome des projets de conseil.
* Vous veillez à ce que les accords contractuels, les normes de qualité ainsi que les exigences d'efficacité soient respectés dans vos mandats clients.
* Au sein de l'équipe de conseil, vous vous impliquez en tant que moteur d'impulsions et d'innovation et favorisez le développement continu de nos services.
* La participation à des événements professionnels et conférences ainsi que la rédaction d'articles spécialisés au nom de Netrics complètent votre champ d'activités.
## Ce que vous devez apporter : ##
* Diplôme en technologies de l'information ou en gestion d'entreprise (université/haute école).
* Plusieurs années d'expérience avérée en tant que CISO, auditeur principal ou dans le domaine de la cybersécurité.
* Expérience de conseil approfondie et compétences stratégiques claires en réflexion et action avec une communication assurée au niveau C-Level et top management.
* Très bonnes connaissances en gouvernance, risque et conformité, protection des données, BCM et gestion des urgences informatiques.
* Connaissances approfondies des normes et cadres courants (ISO 27001, NIST, NIS2, BSI-).
* Des certifications telles que CISM, CISSP, CISA, CRISC sont un avantage.
* Très bonnes compétences en allemand et en anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.
## Ce qui fait de ce poste votre emploi de rêve : ##
* Vous faites partie de la famille Netrics, une équipe jeune et motivée dans un environnement très dynamique.
* Vous aimez naviguer en hors-bord rapide et participer à la détermination de la trajectoire.
* Des conditions de travail flexibles et modernes vous offrent beaucoup de liberté et de possibilités de création.
* Notre stratégie de croissance vous offre de nombreuses possibilités de développement personnel.
* La confiance et la reconnaissance sont la base de notre collaboration.
* Vous bénéficiez de plusieurs avantages sympas tels que des snacks et boissons gratuits, une allocation pour téléphone portable et une cofinancement de votre abonnement aux transports publics ou de votre place de parking.

At David Zwirner, we look to be an industry leader in our field, with our artists at the center of what we do. Our global exhibition program expands beyond our locations in New York, London, Los Angeles, Hong Kong, and Paris, representing over seventy artists and estates.

Home to innovative, singular, and pioneering exhibitions across a variety of media and genres. Active in both the primary and secondary markets, David Zwirner has helped foster the careers of some of the most influential artists today.

s.h: Who will work well with us
s.t:
The ideal candidate is someone who is passionate and interested in the arts/larger creative arena or is eager to learn.
We welcome all individuals entering the workforce, those moving into a new stage of their career or vocation, making a change, returning to work, and those wanting to learn and grow within the industry, to apply.
About the Opportunity
Sales Assistant to Senior Partner
David Zwirner seeks a full-time Sales Assistant to work alongside one of the gallery's Senior Partners. The Sales Assistant will fulfill administrative assistant duties as well as liaise with curators, artists, and clients for the Senior Partner.
Superior writing skills, the ability to time manage and meet deadlines, and a thorough working knowledge of contemporary art are required. This position will involve significant contact with artists and long time clients and other art industry professionals therefore discretion and poise are essential. This position may be scheduled Mondays - Fridays or Tuesdays - Saturdays depending on gallery needs.
Candidates must be diligent, extremely organized, and possess excellent time management and communication skills.

s.h: Support Senior Partner with roster of artists
s.t:
Assist with general artist management of artists’ studios and estates, with exhibitions, requests, press, image requests, general studio requests, events, appraisals and artist care.
Monitor all artists’ solo/group exhibitions, both domestic and international, manage checklists and loans.
Support with gallery exhibition planning globally.
Liaise with other gallery staff regarding all aspects of inventory & exhibition management: production, shipping, framing, photography, research, etc.
Create and manage client lists for exhibition previews/dinners, support Director during openings.

s.h: Provide broad sales support to Senior Partner
s.t:
Manage Senior Partner's sales, help create sales offers, coordinate and prepare for client viewings and prepare insurance appraisals.
Conduct post-sale tasks including preparing invoices and coordinating shipping.

Business Development Representative
Turn strong, growing inbound demand into qualified pipeline — supported by targeted ABX outbound and the industry’s biggest events
There are a lot of security companies out there, but no one is doing what Nucleus is doing: giving security teams the ability to run the most effective vulnerability and exposure management program possible. Some of the largest enterprises and government agencies in the world run on our platform, and we’re growing fast. Top-tier venture funding, an amazing team who will fight beside you to accomplish the impossible, great benefits, and fully remote.
Here’s the good news about this seat: our inbound demand is strong and growing. Your primary job is to work it well — respond fast, qualify sharply, and turn real interest into meetings your AE counterparts are glad to take. You’ll back that up with targeted outbound into named accounts as part of our account-based (ABX) program, and you’ll represent Nucleus face to face at the industry’s biggest security events a few times a year.
Why this role exists
This is a new seat created by growth — driven in large part by inbound volume we want to convert better and faster. Your individual output is visible and it matters. You’ll also be joining a leader whose real strength is developing top-performing BDRs: structured onboarding, weekly coaching and mock calls, and a documented track record of promoting reps into account executive, solutions engineering, customer success, and marketing roles.

Own inbound — this is the priority. Be the first, fast, credible response to the people raising their hands: demo requests, content and webinar leads, event follow-up, and trial interest. Qualify with real discovery — need, timing, environment, decision process — and convert genuine interest into meetings that stick. Speed and judgment both matter: our buyers are busy, and the first good conversation usually wins.
Support the ABX program with targeted outbound. Outbound here is deliberate, not a numbers game. You’ll work a defined set of high-value named accounts alongside Marketing and your AEs — using intent and account signals to time your outreach — so outbound reinforces the accounts we’ve collectively decided matter most.
Personalize everything, and use AI to do it well. Our buyers are technical and busy. You’ll write outreach and follow-up that sounds like a person who understands their world — and you’ll use AI tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) every day to research faster and sharpen your messaging.
Run a clean process. Manage inbound routing, accounts, and follow-up in Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Outreach, and Gong — and partner closely with your AEs and Marketing to act on campaign signals fast.
Represent Nucleus at our biggest events. A few times a year, our BDRs are the front line at RSAC, Black Hat, the Gartner Security & Risk Management Summit, and other key events — proactively engaging people in and around our booth, qualifying on the spot, and booking high-quality meetings. Expect roughly 3–4 events a year, plus our annual company and sales kickoff.
Your first 90 days
We’ve run this playbook before, and we don’t leave ramp to chance:
First 30 days
By 60 days
By 90 days
Structured onboarding and product training. Learn our market, ICP, and the vulnerability and exposure management problems our buyers face. Shadow calls, run mock calls, and start handling live inbound with close coaching.
Owning inbound response and qualification for your patch, with outbound sequences live into your named ABX accounts. Weekly 1:1s and email-writing sessions to sharpen your craft.
Fully ramped and holding your own number — converting inbound into qualified meetings, supporting ABX outbound, and confident enough in the material to represent Nucleus in front of a security buyer.

2–4+ years in sales or business development — BDR/SDR, inside sales, or another customer-facing role. Experience handling real inbound volume with a high qualification bar is especially relevant.
Sharp qualification instincts. You can tell a genuine opportunity from a tire-kicker quickly, and you protect your AEs’ calendars without dropping real interest on the floor.
Outbound capability too. You can build and run a thoughtful, targeted sequence into a named account when it matters — not just work a queue.
Cybersecurity or technical SaaS experience preferred. Holding a credible conversation with a security buyer is a meaningful advantage.
Strong communication. Concise and credible in writing and on the phone with senior technical people.
Comfortable in person. You genuinely enjoy meeting people face to face and can open a conversation with a stranger on a busy expo floor.
AI-fluent. Using AI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT, and Claude in your daily workflow is a requirement, not a bonus.
Tech-savvy. Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Gong, Slack, Teams, and Zoom.
Curious, resilient, and coachable. You want to be coached — this is a team where you’ll get real feedback and be expected to use it.
Nice to have: selling into U.S. Federal, Defense, or State & Local government; an established cybersecurity network; a bachelor’s or associate degree.
If you have less experience than the range above but can show real results and genuine curiosity about security, we’d still like to hear from you. We hire for trajectory and coachability, not just years on a resume.
Why you should be excited
The mission. We automate enterprise vulnerability and exposure management so security teams can prioritize and mitigate risk, at scale — working toward a world where remediation outpaces exploitation.
Warm demand to work with. You’re not starting from zero. Inbound interest is real and growing, and your job is to make the most of it.
The career path. A launchpad, run by a leader who builds and promotes top performers into AE, solutions engineering, customer success, and marketing roles.
Nucleus believes “work is people”, and when our people succeed, our company succeeds.

**Localisation :** Zurich, Suisse

**Faites progresser des domaines d'affaires de pointe grâce à votre expertise **
Chez Deloitte Consulting, vous accompagnez les organisations avec nos autres spécialistes en stratégie technologique et transformation pour développer des stratégies et mettre en œuvre des systèmes qui créent de la valeur commerciale et stimulent la performance.
Deloitte est un partenaire mondial d'élite ServiceNow et soutient plus de 7 000 organisations dans le monde entier dans la transformation de leurs opérations grâce à l'automatisation des flux de travail d'entreprise et à l'IA intégrée.
Ensemble, vous orchestrez la gestion des services informatiques, l'automatisation des flux de travail et les initiatives de transformation numérique avec ServiceNow comme plateforme centrale - de la planification stratégique à l'excellence opérationnelle.
Vous façonnez des transformations numériques qui changent les organisations - et faites une réelle différence dans le processus.
**Comment vous pouvez avoir un impact **
Vous n'êtes pas seulement un exécutant de demandes - vous êtes un consultant en solutions. Dans ce rôle :
* Conseiller les dirigeants et les équipes opérationnelles pour résoudre leurs défis IT et commerciaux les plus complexes
* Concevoir des solutions ServiceNow qui automatisent les processus, augmentent l'efficacité et créent une véritable valeur commerciale
* Diriger des projets de transformation - de la stratégie et la conception à la mise en œuvre et au-delà
* Apprendre continuellement auprès de partenaires expérimentés et vous développer en expert en conseil recherché
* Grandir avec nous : votre expertise en ServiceNow et en conseil ouvre des portes à des projets nationaux et internationaux ainsi qu'à des opportunités de carrière
**Qui recherchons-nous ? **

* Intéressé par le conseil ServiceNow et ayant étudié la gestion des systèmes d'information
* Maîtrise du allemand et de l'anglais - Vous communiquez avec assurance avec des clients germanophones mais aussi avec des clients internationaux
* Expertise fonctionnelle - Vous comprenez les exigences commerciales et pouvez les traduire dans le "langage" ServiceNow
* Esprit d'analyste d'affaires - Vous pensez en processus, pas seulement en fonctionnalités

* Compréhension IT - Vous connaissez les processus IT, les fondamentaux ITIL ou la gestion des services IT
* Expérience en conseil - Vous avez déjà travaillé sur des projets clients ou en environnement de conseil
* 1 à 3 ans d'expérience pratique avec ServiceNow (idéalement dans les modules ITSM, ITOM, CSM ou Workflow) ou des plateformes d'automatisation similaires
* Certifications - Développeur ou administrateur certifié ServiceNow
**Votre personnalité ! **
* Motivé à faire un effort supplémentaire - Vous voyez les défis comme des opportunités, pas des obstacles
* Pas de mentalité 9 à 5 - Vous êtes prêt à investir dans la réussite du projet
* Faim d'apprendre - Vous êtes curieux, vous vous développez activement et souhaitez acquérir des compétences en conseil
* Orienté client - Vous comprenez que votre travail a un impact réel sur l'entreprise. La valeur client est au centre de ce que vous faites !
* Esprit d'équipe - Vous aimez travailler avec des collègues, des clients et des équipes transversales
* Esprit agile - Vous assumez toujours la responsabilité de vos actions
**Votre équipe **
En rejoignant l'équipe de notre bureau de Zurich, vous serez intégré dès le départ à un groupe diversifié de collègues sympathiques. Nous prenons votre développement au sérieux et vous proposons un programme complet de formation interne et externe.

Vous bénéficierez également de notre expertise alliant une compréhension approfondie de la technologie, d'excellentes compétences en communication et une compréhension globale des affaires.

Attendez-vous à collaborer avec certaines des plus grandes organisations en Suisse et dans le monde pour introduire le changement qui a vraiment un impact pour leur entreprise.
**La vie chez Deloitte **
Chez Deloitte, vos idées créent un impact et suscitent un changement significatif pour nos clients, nos collaborateurs et la société. Votre expertise, votre parcours et votre perspective uniques nous aident à trouver de nouvelles solutions aux défis les plus complexes afin d'éclairer l'avenir de ceux que notre travail touche. Chez Deloitte, vous pouvez construire une carrière qui vous inspire et vous dynamise. Chez Deloitte, vous choisissez votre impact.
En Suisse, nous fournissons des services spécifiques à l'industrie dans les domaines de l'audit & assurance, fiscalité & juridique, stratégie, gestion des risques & transactions, et technologie & transformation.

Avec près de 3 000 collaborateurs répartis sur six sites, nous servons des entreprises et organisations de toutes tailles dans tous les secteurs. Nous offrons un travail significatif et stimulant, un environnement inclusif et bienveillant où vous pouvez être vous-même et où vous ne cesserez jamais de grandir.

Sales Development Representative
Edinburgh
Wordsmith
Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.
We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems.
Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens.
We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with.
More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling, and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe, and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

We’re hiring a Sales Development Representative (SDR) to spearhead our outbound engine and book high-quality opportunities with in-house legal teams.
This is the frontline of our growth. You’ll be responsible for finding the right accounts, crafting compelling outreach, and breaking into companies. You’ll work hand-in-hand with our Account Executives (AEs) and Marketing teams to build a predictable pipeline.
This is an early-stage environment. Things move fast, priorities shift, and there isn’t always a clear playbook. You’ll need to be resilient, highly organized, and willing to experiment with new ways to get a prospect’s attention.

Build and execute targeted outbound campaigns (email, cold calling, LinkedIn) to general counsel and legal leaders.
Consistently hit and exceed monthly meeting-booked and pipeline targets.
Partner closely with AEs to strategize on key accounts and ensure smooth handoffs.
Act as a feedback loop for Marketing and Product by tracking what messaging resonates most with the market.
Maintain meticulous CRM data — keeping track of accounts, prospects, and outreach activity.

SaaS sales or lead generation experience (experience selling to legal, finance, or compliance is a major plus, but not required).
A relentless work ethic — you aren't afraid of the phone and view "no" as data, not a deterrent.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; you can cut through the noise with clear, value-led messaging.
High curiosity and coachability; you want to master the product, the market, and the art of sales.
High ownership — you take responsibility for outcomes, not just logging activities.
Organized, consistent, and reliable with excellent time management.
How we work
We’re an in-office team. We work together because it makes us faster, sharper, and more effective. You should expect to be in the office our out visiting clients as your default.
This is a high performance environment. We set a high bar, move quickly, and expect people to take ownership of real problems.
There isn’t always a clear path. The people who do well here figure things out, stay close to the work, and keep pushing until they get to the right outcome.
This role requires patience, structure, and strong judgement. You’ll be trusted to run complex deals with a high degree of autonomy.
Why Wordsmith
We’re in a period of strong momentum — growing quickly, winning new customers, and expanding into larger accounts.
The product is landing well, the market is ready, and the team is scaling to meet demand.
If you want to be in the room, close meaningful deals, and grow quickly in a high bar environment, this is one of the best places to do it.

Location: Remote – South Africa
Employment Type: Full-Time
Working Hours: 08:00–17:00 US Pacific Time, Monday to Friday
South African Hours: Approximately 17:00–02:00 SAST
Commission: Performance-based commission in addition to monthly compensation
About the Opportunity
We are recruiting for a growing US-based outsourced business development agency that partners with B2B companies to build and manage their outbound sales pipelines.
The company provides clients with a complete outbound business development function, including prospecting, cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn outreach and appointment setting.
They are looking for an experienced Sales Development Representative (SDR) who is confident speaking with US decision-makers and can independently manage outbound activity from prospecting through to qualified meeting booking.
This is not a traditional call-centre position. The successful candidate will operate with a high degree of autonomy and will be expected to take ownership of their pipeline, follow-ups and activity without requiring constant supervision.

Conduct high-volume B2B cold calling into the US market.
Engage founders, sales leaders, Heads of Growth and other senior decision-makers.
Book qualified sales meetings with prospective clients.
Manage follow-up activity independently and consistently.
Use email and LinkedIn outreach alongside cold calling to engage prospects.
Research and identify relevant prospects within defined Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs).
Maintain accurate prospect, activity and pipeline information within the CRM.
Write clear, professional and personalised follow-up emails.
Manage prospects through multiple touchpoints until a meeting is secured.
Provide daily activity updates and weekly reporting on meetings booked and pipeline activity.
Initially support the company's own new-business pipeline before transitioning to outbound campaigns for its clients.
Professionally represent different client brands when conducting outbound campaigns.
Maintain excellent CRM hygiene, notes and follow-up tasks.

3+ years of B2B outbound sales, SDR, BDR or appointment-setting experience.
Strong track record of cold calling as a primary sales activity.
Previous experience engaging US-based B2B prospects is strongly preferred.
US or Australian outbound campaign experience would be advantageous.
Confident communicating with founders, sales leaders and senior business decision-makers.
Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral and professional phone manner.
Strong written English and the ability to write professional follow-up emails without relying heavily on templates.
Comfortable conducting unscripted, natural sales conversations.

Highly self-directed and able to manage follow-ups without being chased.
Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
Commercially driven and motivated by targets and commission.
Strong organisational skills and attention to CRM and pipeline management.
Must be genuinely comfortable working 17:00–02:00 SAST on a long-term basis.
Reliable internet connection and a suitable professional remote-working environment.
Technology & Sales Tools

s.h: Experience with the following would be beneficial
s.t:
Go High Level
LinkedIn Sales Navigator
Gmail
Explorium
Vibe
CRM and sales dialling platforms
Prospecting and list-building tools
Candidates with experience using comparable CRM, dialler and sales engagement platforms will also be considered.
Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate has approximately 3–6 years of B2B outbound sales experience and has previously worked on international campaigns, particularly within the US market.
You should be someone who can be given a target market and take ownership of it. You understand that successful outbound sales requires more than simply making calls — you research prospects, manage follow-ups, personalise communication, maintain your pipeline and consistently work towards qualified meetings.
Experience within SaaS, outsourced business development, lead generation, sales agencies, marketing agencies or other B2B environments would be particularly relevant.
Candidates who have previously built their own outbound sequences, conducted prospect research, developed target lists or supported/led small outbound teams are also encouraged to apply.
Performance & Commission
In addition to monthly compensation, the position offers a performance-based commission structure:
USD $75 for every qualified meeting held.
10% of the first month's revenue for any new client deal closed from a meeting you booked.
A qualified meeting must match the defined target customer profile, include an appropriate decision-maker or influencer and successfully take place.
What Success Looks Like

s.h: During the first 90 days, success will be measured by
s.t:
Consistent outbound activity.
A predictable flow of qualified meetings.
Strong cold-calling performance.

Consistent and proactive follow-up.
Accurate CRM and pipeline management.
Professional communication with US prospects.
The ability to operate independently and take ownership of results.
As the role develops, you will have the opportunity to work across additional client campaigns and take greater ownership of outbound business development activity.

Candidates should be comfortable completing an introductory video as part of the application process.
The interview process may also include a live mock cold call and follow-up sales scenario to assess phone presence, communication, objection handling and follow-up ability.

About Revelo
Revelo provides top quality tech talent from Latin American countries to US and Canadian companies hiring remotely.
We are a tech first company that uses our technology to source, match and allocate remote digital workers faster, cheaper and more accurately than competitors. We are in the middle of the biggest shift to remote work that the world has ever seen - come be a part of it!
With large amounts of capital being injected into Brazil and Latin America over the previous 15 years from both national and international venture capital and capital equity, there has been a significant increase in the education of professionals and adolescents with skills in all aspects of technology (software development, data science, product development, product management, crypto, and so forth).

This rapid growth of maturing companies has made Latin America a key producer of high caliber tech talent. The pandemic opened the eyes of North American companies to the opportunity of accessing that talent for a new pool of candidates beyond the saturated and more competitive markets they’re used to recruiting in.
Born in 2015 out of São Paulo, over the course of 8 years we’ve gained vast expertise in sourcing, recruiting and placing tech talent throughout Latin America. We’re now able to share that knowledge and help companies connect to the right talent to build their technology.

Mit mehr als 20 Jahren Erfahrung, bieten wir Werkstätten zukunftsorientierte Lösungen für Kfz\-Mehrmarkendiagnose, Fahrzeugkalibrierung, Klimaservice und Abgasuntersuchung. Wir sind Spezialisten und einer der führenden Entwickler für Fahrzeugdiagnose.
Bei uns fließt nicht nur Arbeit, sondern Herzblut und Leidenschaft in jeden Tag ein.
Diese Werte sind unser Antrieb, der uns seit über 20 Jahre Erfolgsgeschichte schreiben lässt.
### Deine Aufgaben
* Betreuung von Bestandskunden und Gewinnung neuer Kunden im Bereich Wartung und Vertrieb technischer Produkte (Werkstattausrüstung).
* Deine Kunden berätst und schulst Du hinsichtlich der Einsatzmöglichkeiten und erarbeitest individuelle Lösungen.
* Durch Deine kompetente Beratung und Präsenz am Markt erschließt Du gezielt Geschäftspotentiale und gewinnst neue Kunden und Wartungsverträge.
* Deine Aktivitäten pflegst und planst Du selbstständig.
### Dein Profil
* Du hast Spaß, etwas zu bewegen, Netzwerke auszubauen und Kunden durch kompetente Beratung und Service zu begeistern.
* Du hast eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Mechaniker, Automobilfachmann (m/w/d) oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung im technischen Bereich.
* Die Betreuung von Bestandskunden und Gewinnung neuer Kunden ist Deine Leidenschaft.
* Eigeninitiative, ein strukturierter Arbeitsstil, Team\-Spirit sowie die erforderliche Reisebereitschaft bringst Du mit. Du agierst vom Home\-Office.
* Berufserfahrung im Umfeld von Kfz\-Werkstätten ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung \- mit technischer Affinität wirst Du bestens auf Deine Aufgabe vorbereitet.
* Fließende Deutsch\- und Französischkenntnisse sind zwingende Voraussetzung.
* Wohnort im Verkaufsgebiet in der Westschweiz ist zwingend erforderlich (idealerweise Grossraum Fribourg, Lausanne oder Biel)
### Wir bieten
* Eine spannende und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem innovativen Unternehmen.
* Attraktive Vergütung und leistungsorientierte Prämien.
* Firmenfahrzeug, auch zur privaten Nutzung.
* Umfangreiche Einarbeitung und regelmäßige Schulungen.
* Moderne Arbeitsmittel und digitale Tools.
* Flache Hierarchien und ein motiviertes Team.
